Based on the given passages, here is how to perform skill moves in FIFA 16 on Xbox One:

To execute a skill move while standing, press and hold the LT button and then tap the RB button. This will allow your player to perform various skill moves such as flip fouls, step-overs, and heel-to-heel turns.

You can find more tutorials and guides on executing skill moves in FIFA 16 by visiting the official website or watching video tutorials available online. Additionally, the complete FIFA 16 Skill Moves guide with a list and tutorial videos can be found on the official website.
